svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: ATDS threshold and detour scheduling
svg.desc: Left: sensors report to a central base station over a multi-hop tree and are grouped into clusters; three chargers are idle, departing, and charging. Right: a charger bound for target cluster A may detour to a candidate cluster B that lies inside a corridor around the direct path and whose state of charge is below its threshold; a cluster outside the corridor is never a candidate.
svg.text: Per-cluster thresholds, and one detour decision at departure
200 × 200 m field · Mean-Shift clusters, R = 10 m · a charger parks at a cluster centre
Fig. 2 of the paper, schematic, not to scale
half-width d_f·R around the direct path (d_f = 3, R = 10 m);
clusters outside it are never candidates, however urgent.
a cluster inside the corridor whose lowest SoC is below its
own threshold θ; at most K = 5 are offered to the agent.
a threshold agent resets θ per cluster every 60 s; a route agent
decides once, at departure: a = 0 direct or a = i detour.
(a) uses the geometry of Fig. 1 of the paper, (b) the coordinates of its Fig. 2; both restyled for the site.
